paper_anchor: Section 6.1 Figures 3-4; Appendix D Figures D.1-D.2
exact_statement_under_test: On the six paper conditions (Gaussian aspect ratios n/m in {1,4,50} and HTMP kappa in {0.1,0.5,100}), fifth-order PRISM has stable residual convergence while the fixed-interval PolarExpress control degrades.
scoped_alignment_rule: PRISM reaches RMS residual 0.01 in every condition and seed.
PRISM is no slower than PolarExpress for every paired condition and seed.
PolarExpress either misses the threshold or has a larger first-hit range than PRISM.
uncertainty: Report mean, sample standard deviation, and full first-hit distribution across 18 samples.
negative_control: The literal HTMP off-diagonal printed by the cited generator must violate the PSD invariant and exit nonzero.
failure_behavior: Data integrity or optimizer-fit failures exit nonzero; scientific alignment is reported from the predeclared rule without being forced.
